grim_lag_threshold: Two players play a prisoner's dilemma every period forever, discounting future payoffs by δ per period. Per-period payoffs: both cooperate 4 each; both defect 3 each; a defector facing a cooperator gets 6 and the cooperator gets 1. Both players use grim trigger: cooperate until a defection is discovered, then defect forever. Monitoring is imperfect: a defection in period t is only discovered at the end of period t + 2, and punishment (mutual defection forever) starts in period t + 3. Until it is discovered, the deviator keeps defecting and the other player keeps cooperating. What is the smallest discount factor δ at which no player gains by deviating from cooperation? Give δ rounded to 4 decimal places. Reply with only the number.
